newsitem.title: UK: UK car production falls 1.2 pct in 3 mths to Dec.
newsitem.headline: UK car production falls 1.2 pct in 3 mths to Dec.

text.p: Total UK car production fell a seasonally adjusted 1.2 percent in the three months to December 31 compared with the previous quarter, the Office for National Statistics said on Monday.
Production allocated for export fell by 2.6 percent but home production rose by 0.7 percent.
Compared with the same period a year ago, total car output rose by 12.8 percent. Production allocated for export rose by 35.0 percent but home production fell by 7.1 percent.
Total commercial vehicle output for the fourth quarter of 1996 was 7.5 percent up on the previous quarter and 23.8 percent up on the corresponding period a year ago.
